tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Returns the word-level speech transcript of one media asset: language and words [{text, startSec, endSec}]. Only assets the user has transcribed have one — NOT_FOUND means ask the user to run Transcribe on the clip in Frapea. Use the timestamps to align cuts with what is being said.

tools.name: create_motion_composition
tools.description: Creates a MOTION COMPOSITION — an animated graphic (infographic, title, promo end-card, chart…) written as a React TSX component. tools.name: update_motion_composition

Every clip playing the composition re-renders. preview:true returns one large frame of the result with the reply.

tools.name: get_motion_composition
tools.description: Returns a motion composition's manifest and full TSX sources.

tools.name: list_motion_compositions
tools.description: Lists the project's motion compositions: id, mediaRef (for add_clips), name, size, fps, duration and the editable props schema.

tools.name: create_timeline
tools.description: Creates a new timeline in the project and returns its id. Set fps, width and height for the target format (e.g. 1080×1920 @30 for a vertical short). The new timeline starts with one video and one audio track; spare tracks appear automatically as clips land.

tools.name: add_clips

tools.name: split_clips
tools.description: Blades clips at a timeline frame. Splits every listed clip (and its linked partner) into two independent clips at atFrame. Frames are in the target timeline's fps. Use with get_timeline to find clip ids first.

tools.name: remove_clips
tools.description: Deletes clips (lift — leaves a gap). Linked partners are NOT removed automatically; pass both ids of a pair to delete it whole. To close the gap too, use ripple_delete_ranges instead.

tools.name: ripple_delete_ranges
tools.description: Extracts [fromFrame, toFrame) on one track and shifts everything after it left to close the gap (sync-locked tracks follow). The go-to tool for tightening a cut or removing a bad take.

tools.name: set_clip_properties
tools.description: Adjusts a clip. Only the provided fields change. Mix: volume (0–2, 1 = unity), fadeInFrames / fadeOutFrames (gain or opacity ramps at the edges). tools.name: move_clips
tools.description: Moves clips to new positions (linked partners follow automatically). Each move: clipId, toStartFrame, optional toTrackId (same-kind track). Overwrite semantics — landing on another clip trims it like a drag-drop.

tools.name: set_active_timeline
tools.description: Sets which timeline the project opens on (and what the user sees if the editor is open). Purely a convenience — every tool here takes an explicit timelineId regardless.

tools.name: set_project_settings
tools.description: Updates a timeline's fps / width / height (clips keep their timing; content re-fits) and/or renames it. Only provided fields change.

tools.name: search_media
tools.description: Semantic search over the project's media. tools.name: remove_words

tools.name: remove_silence
tools.description: Cuts silent gaps inside a clip: any pause between transcribed words longer than minGapSec becomes a ripple delete (a small margin is kept so speech never clips). Typical minGapSec: 0.6 tight, 1.0 balanced, 1.5 loose.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Reverts the most recent edit THIS agent session made to the project (one step per call; repeat to go further). Cannot revert other tabs' or the user's edits.

Pass frames (timeline frame numbers, max 12). Use after every edit

tools.description: Ripple-inserts media segments: everything at/after atFrame shifts right to make room (clips under the cut split). Same clip shape as add_clips. Use to splice a shot INTO an existing sequence without overwriting.

tools.name: organize_media

tools.name: close_project
tools.description: Navigates the user's Frapea tab back to the project manager and releases this session's headless runtime for the project.

tools.name: start_transcription
tools.description: Transcribes one asset even if automatic transcription is switched off. Speech transcripts otherwise appear on their own. Returns the project's analysis status; poll get_analysis_status, then read get_transcript.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_timeline, get_media, get_transcript, add_clips, generate_captions, read_skill, start_transcription, generate_voiceover, search_stock_media · Private data: connect, get_projects, create_motion_composition, update_motion_composition, inspect_media, inspect_timeline, get_bug_report, organize_media, new_project, connect_media_folder, generate_voiceover, search_stock_media, download_stock_media, search_sounds, download_sound, add_sfx, retry_analysis, organize_pool · Public sink: connect, get_timeline, generate_captions, list_voiceover_models, apply_layout · Destructive: get_media, get_transcript, create_timeline, add_clips, remove_clips, ripple_delete_ranges, manage_effects, manage_transitions, manage_tracks, move_clips, remove_words, remove_silence, organize_media, read_skill, generate_voiceover, search_sounds, set_keyframes, track_faces, list_face_tracks, merge_faces.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_timeline, get_media, get_transcript, add_clips, generate_captions, read_skill, start_transcription, generate_voiceover, search_stock_media · Private data: connect, get_projects, create_motion_composition, update_motion_composition, inspect_media, inspect_timeline, get_bug_report, organize_media, new_project, connect_media_folder, generate_voiceover, search_stock_media, download_stock_media, search_sounds, download_sound, add_sfx, retry_analysis, organize_pool · Public sink: connect, get_timeline, generate_captions, list_voiceover_models, apply_layout · Destructive: get_media, get_transcript, create_timeline, add_clips, remove_clips, ripple_delete_ranges, manage_effects, manage_transitions, manage_tracks, move_clips, remove_words, remove_silence, organize_media, read_skill, generate_voiceover, search_sounds, set_keyframes, track_faces, list_face_tracks, merge_faces
